summary.S: AWS-certified cloud professional building serverless applications on AWS.

aboutIntro.S:
I focus on cloud architecture because it connects design, backend engineering, security, operations, and business outcomes.
This portfolio is built as a working system, not only a static site, so each feature gives me a practical reason to make architecture decisions and document tradeoffs.

aboutFocus.S: My current direction is AWS-focused: serverless applications, clean API boundaries, DynamoDB access patterns, event-driven processing, media delivery, and reliable deployment practices.

aboutBuilds.S:
Portfolio CRM features with public and protected admin workflows.
Backend APIs with Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, and SES.
Media upload flows that store images in S3 and serve them through CloudFront.
Project case studies that explain architecture decisions and tradeoffs.

aboutValues.S:
Clear documentation
Practical architecture
Reliable delivery
Security-aware defaults
